content:
Apple's annual flagship event is just around the corner. The "major announcement" recently teased by new CEO John Ternus will take place on September 9, with market rumours suggesting new iPhones, Apple Watch models and AirPods will be unveiled — and possibly even more surprises. Here are the six main products expected to make an appearance.

iPhone

Apple is preparing to unveil three brand-new flagship iPhones at the event. Two models from the iPhone 18 Pro series will take centre stage, joined by the long-awaited foldable iPhone Ultra.

  • iPhone 18 Pro: A20 Pro chip, significantly upgraded camera specs, new body colours, smaller Dynamic Island
  • iPhone 18 Pro Max: Larger battery capacity and greater efficiency, delivering the best battery performance ever
  • iPhone Ultra: Apple's first-ever foldable iPhone

Apple Watch

The Apple Watch has traditionally been a staple of the September event, and this year two new models are expected to be unveiled. Both will feature more powerful chips and new health features, along with other improvements.

  • Apple Watch Ultra 4: New health sensors, refreshed design and additional changes
  • Apple Watch Series 12: Upgraded S-series chip, all-day heart rate monitoring, new ceramic case option

AirPods

AirPods 5 is on the horizon, becoming the sixth major new product. Recent leaks have suggested AirPods with cameras might appear in September, but according to Mark Gurman, that product won't arrive until 2027 — only the AirPods 5 will be unveiled next week.

  • AirPods 5: Updated standard and active noise-cancellation models, possibly with a new chip

Wildcard: Apple smart home products

iPhones, Apple Watch and AirPods are pretty much the standard fare at the September event. However, rumours suggest several brand-new smart home products will also debut that day, including the long-awaited home hub with a display.

  • HomePad / HomePod Touch: All-new home hub with a 7-inch touchscreen
  • HomePod mini 2: New chip, improved sound quality, Siri AI support
  • All-new Apple TV 4K: More powerful chip, Siri AI support, updated remote

Other Apple products that could be unveiled but are more likely to be delayed until October

Apple is reportedly preparing several other products for release sometime this autumn, so there's a chance they could make an appearance at the September 9 event.

While more likely to officially debut in October, the MacBook Ultra, M6 MacBook Pro, M6 iMac or OLED iPad mini could all potentially crash the event. Other smart home products aren't out of the question either, such as an all-new full-size HomePod.

However, according to the latest reports, the new iPhones, Apple Watch models, AirPods 5, and possibly smart home products are all expected to be unveiled next week.

Which upcoming Apple product are you most looking forward to next week? Share your thoughts in the comments.
